text:
elaine: heads-up — noticed a spike in p95 latency for /v1/embeddings around 03:12 UTC that correlates with a surge of high-dim requests. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/boards/embeds-slo?panel=dim-breakdown :thinking_face:

ops-bot: ALERT triggered: embeddings.p95 > 450ms (5m) — tenants affected: 23, top tenant: corp-x

mike: can you paste a sample trace/id? curious if it's single tenant or distributed noise

elaine: trace ids attached (sanitized): `trace-9a7f`, `trace-9a82`. seeing many requests with `dims=1024` and payload_size ~ 1.2MiB.

anya: high dims are expected to be heavier, but we shouldn't see p95 jump that much. are we double-counting KV cache misses?

mike: possibility. another angle — our telemetry has exploded cardinality when we tag by exact dims. we currently emit `embed.request.dim=<numeric>` which is insane for dashboards and alerts

elaine: yeah that's on me — early debugging added numeric dim tag. solution candidate: bucket dims into `small|medium|large|xlarge` to reduce cardinality. propose buckets: <=64, 65-256, 257-1024, >1024

anya: bucketing helps dashboards but we also need accuracy for cost-modeling. Sampling could preserve accuracy while reducing ingest. we could reservoir-sample 1% of requests but stratify by bucket so rare customers still show up

mike: stratified reservoir sampling + bucket tags sounds reasonable. implementation sketch: `if random() < sample_rate[bucket]: emit full payload telemetry else emit light telemetry (counts, units)`

elaine: question: where do we compute `bucket`? ingress layer has sequence length/dim hint in header `x-embed-dim` from clients. we can derive bucket pre-routing and apply sample policy there

kevin: concern — header is optional (clients may not send). for those we'll fallback to preflight sniff or runtime inferred dims, but that's late and increases overhead. Could we add soft-requirement to SDKs and console docs?

anya: we can make it soft for GA, but enforce for dedicated/private. SDK update + console badge warning — plan the enforcement in 6 weeks

mike: about telemetry cost — current raw metrics rate is ~420k events/day, with many unique dim tags. Proposed change expected to drop to ~18k/day with buckets + 1% stratified sampling. ops estimate?

elaine: ops estimates ~80% reduction in cardinality costs and 40% reduction in ingestion egress. I'll ask billing for rough cost delta once we have numbers

ops-bot: NOTE: change will affect existing Grafana panels that query `by(dim)` — owners must update queries to `by(dim_bucket)` or use `histogram_quantile` on `dim_histogram` if we expose that

mike: dashboard plan: create a `dim_bucket` panel that shows p50/p95/p99 and units-per-request per bucket. create an annotation for rollout start. also add a heatmap for tenant vs bucket to catch hot tenants

anya: for alerting, do not reuse current p95 alert thresholds. smaller buckets will have different baselines. propose per-bucket dynamic thresholds initially (alert if > baseline*1.5) while we collect 2 weeks of data

elaine: rollout proposal: canary 10% tenants (by usage percentile) for 72h, then 50% for 48h, then full. telemetry mode behind feature-flag `embed_dim_telemetry_v2` so we can rollback quickly

kevin: make sure throttles/quotas behave the same. If sampling hides high-cost requests we might undercharge/overcommit. need to link sampling to quota accounting path — counting should remain deterministic (no sampling) for billing. sampling only affects observability payloads

mike: agreed — split concerns: metrics_sampling != quota_counting. emit minimal counters always (tenant.units += estimated_units) and sampled detailed payloads for traces/latency histograms

anya: small code snippet for tagging in ingress (pseudo):
```
bucket = bucket_for(dim)
metrics.counter("embed.requests_total", {"tenant": tenant_id, "dim_bucket": bucket})
if sample_should_emit(bucket, tenant_id):
  metrics.histogram("embed.latency_ms", latency_ms, {"dim_bucket": bucket, "trace_id": trace})
  send_trace(full_payload)
else:
  metrics.counter("embed.sampled_light", {"dim_bucket": bucket})
```

elaine: owners: I'll do SDK/docs + console badges (owner: elaine). Mike will do dashboard panels/alter queries (owner: mike). Anya will own sampling algorithm + infra rollout (owner: anya). Kevin will validate quotas/billing path (owner: kevin)

mike: can we get a short RFC/PR with diagrams? I'd like a sequence diagram: client -> ingress (bucket + counters) -> router -> runtime (emit sampled traces) -> metrics pipeline (tag transform)

elaine: I'll write a 1-pager and attach early tomorrow. Also will add a small e2e test in `eng-platform/embeds/sampling` that simulates mixed dims and validates counters vs sampled histograms

anya: nits: add a dimension for `client_hint=preflight|none|sniffed` so we can evaluate incentive to upgrade SDKs. Also include `sampling_version` label so old/new telemetry can be separated

kevin: +1 on labels. remember cardinality budget — keep label values bounded (`preflight`, `sdk_hint`, `sniffed`)

mike: SGTM. once we have the 1-pager I'll do the dashboard PR and a canary config. schedule: try to ship canary next Tue after QA

elaine: thanks all. tagging infra for cost estimates and billing for delta. will post RFC link when ready :thumbsup:
